description: Campinas - Sistema de partilha de Bicicletas de Coruche is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município de Coruche. Investment in this type of system meets sustainable development policies, promoting the use of alternative forms of individual transport, especially in daily commuting, from home to work or school and associated small commuting. Coverage: Município de Coruche. The portal shows the English title as "Campinas - Coruche Bicycle Sharing System" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Município de Coruche. The listing shows 2025-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
